prompt: Which Vietnamese professor explained the mysterious case of two monks said to have been meditating for over 400 years, as shown in a YouTube video posted on April 4, 2023?
answer: The professor was **Nguyễn Lân Cường**, a Vietnamese archaeologist and physical anthropologist (formerly of the Vietnam Institute of Archaeology). He examined the remains at Đậu Pagoda and proposed that the monks underwent a distinctive form of **“thiền táng” (meditation burial)** or **“tượng táng” (burial-statue preservation)**, involving lacquer and layers of materials such as termite-soil clay, sawdust, and paper. He acknowledged that the preservation of their organs and tissues remains incompletely explained.
